alignments.note: Hiphil participle rendered as a light verb with its complement; headed on *sick*, which carries the lexeme under rule 44, and discontinuous around the object under rule 25.
Noun with the supplied *the* that determines it under rule 15.
Waw rendered by the adversative connective the ASV wrote (rule 14).

The ASV writes *the desire* for this noun in the recast temporal clause and resumes the same referent as *it* in the main clause, so both realizations are its one discontinuous unit under rule 25's sentence that the morpheme denoting a resumed subject need not be a pronoun, headed on the first English occurrence; the supplied *the* joins it under rule 15. Reading *it* as an impersonal dummy added under rule 20 was the competing reading, but that sentence governs a cleft or extraposing *it* answering to no morpheme, and here a written nominal answers to it.

The articleless attributive participle is recast as a finite temporal clause, and the supplied *when* realizes that attributive relation and stays with the participle under rule 41; the unit is discontinuous under rule 25. Reading *But when* as one rendering of the waw under rule 55's pair sentence, or the *when* as added under rule 55, were the competing readings; what the ASV subordinated is the subject nominal of the waw's clause rather than that clause itself.
Construct noun as the verbless clause's predicate, taking the construction-supplied copula under rule 20 and the *a* that determines it under rule 15.
Rectum takes the chain's *of* under rule 19.

review_notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment folded *it* into עֵץ's unit as part of a construction-supplied frame. Rule 20 states that the dummy it governs is the presentative *there* and no other, and this *it* is referential — it denotes תַּאֲוָה, which the verse writes and the ASV has already rendered *the desire* — so rule 25's resumption sentence gives it to that noun's discontinuous unit. The predicate keeps only *is a tree*.
The placement of the supplied *when* on בָאָה under rule 41 is retained, with the rule 55 alternatives named in that unit's note.
